title: How to Set and Plan Financial Goals
content: To set effective financial goals: 1. Identify specific objectives (e.g. child education, home purchase, retirement). 2. Assign a target date and estimate future cost accounting for inflation. 3. Determine the required monthly investment needed using compounding formulas. 4. Match asset class to time horizon (short-term goals in debt/FD, long-term goals in equities/SIPs). 5. Track progress regularly and rebalance asset allocation as goals approach maturity.
